title: Free Field Service Software 2026: 7 Real $0 Plans
description: Which field service apps are actually free? ServiceM8, Yardbook, LawnPro, Homeworks, UpBuoy, ResponsiBid and Square: limits, card fees and paid prices.
h1: Free field service software: 7 plans that cost $0 (and their limits)
body:
Searching for free field service software? Here is the short answer from each vendor's own pricing page, checked November 16, 2026: seven tools we track publish a plan that costs $0 a month: ServiceM8, Yardbook, LawnPro, Homeworks, UpBuoy, ResponsiBid and Square. Each free plan has a catch, such as a cap on jobs, customers, users or locations, a higher card fee, or missing features. Jobber, Housecall Pro, GorillaDesk and QuoteIQ have no free plan, only free trials. Below is what each free plan includes, where it stops, and what the first paid plan costs. For every tool's published price in one table, see the field service software pricing tracker.

Sources: each vendor's pricing page, linked from its tool page. Square figures are from Square's Appointments pricing page, checked 2026-11-16. Square is booking and payments software, not route-based field service software, so it has no routing or job-costing features.

Which free plan fits your business

  • Solo lawn care or snow removal: Yardbook Starter has no customer cap on its pricing page and includes scheduling, estimates, invoices, routing, lot measurement and snow removal. The tradeoff is the extra 1% Yardbook fee on online payments. LawnPro Solo has no extra fee listed but caps you at 25 customers. See best lawn care software and lawn care software cost.
  • Any trade, low job volume: ServiceM8 Free covers 30 jobs a month for one user and includes scheduling, quoting, invoicing, recurring jobs and the iOS/Android apps. Once you pass 30 jobs, Starter is $29/mo for 50 jobs with unlimited users.
  • Pool routes: UpBuoy Essential is free for up to 3 pools, which is enough to test the app but not to run a route. See free pool service software for the pool-specific options.
  • Window cleaning and pressure washing quotes: ResponsiBid's free Startup plan includes the quoting calculator, service tiers and auto-upsell, but scheduling and invoicing run through a connected CRM. See pressure washing software and window cleaning business software.
  • Planning to grow past $250K: Homeworks Solo is free, but Homeworks says on its own pricing page that solo operators staying under $250K in revenue may be better served by cheaper options like Yardbook or Jobber.

Invoice Simple's pricing page says "Start for Free", but every plan listed is paid. The free part is the 14-day trial. It is an invoicing and estimates app, not scheduling or dispatch software.

What "free" usually costs you

  • Card fees: free plans often cost more per payment. Yardbook adds 1% on free accounts, Homeworks charges 3.9% + 30¢ on Solo vs 2.9% + 30¢ on Enterprise, and Square charges 3.3% + 30¢ online on Free vs 2.9% + 30¢ on Plus. On $5,000 a month of online card payments, that 0.4-point Square difference is $20 a month.
  • Caps: 30 jobs a month (ServiceM8), 25 customers (LawnPro) or 3 locations (UpBuoy). Count your real weekly visits before you commit.
  • Add-ons: LawnPro sells QuickBooks sync and texting ($25/mo) as add-ons below Plus. Yardbook keeps QuickBooks sync for Enterprise ($49.99/mo).

Comparing what one user and five users would pay? See field service software cost for 1 vs 5 users, and use the software buying checklist before you move your customer list.

faq: Is there free field service software?

Yes. Among the tools we track, ServiceM8 (Free: 1 user, 30 jobs a month), Yardbook (Starter), LawnPro (Solo: up to 25 customers), Homeworks (Solo), UpBuoy (Essential: up to 3 pool locations), ResponsiBid (Startup, quoting only) and Square (Square Free, booking and payments) publish $0/month plans, per their pricing pages checked 2026-11-16.
Does Jobber have a free plan?
No. Jobber offers a 14-day free trial on its Grow plan with no credit card. Its cheapest plan is Core at $29/mo billed annually or $49/mo monthly (checked 2026-11-11).
What is the best free app for a one-person service business?

It depends on volume and trade. ServiceM8 Free allows 30 jobs a month for one user in any trade. Yardbook Starter has no customer cap on its pricing page and suits lawn care and snow removal, but adds a 1% fee on online payments. LawnPro Solo is free up to 25 customers.
Are free field service plans really free?
The subscription is $0, but card payments still cost money: for example, 3.05% + 30¢ on ServiceM8 Pay in the US, 3.9% + 30¢ on Homeworks Solo, and Stripe fees plus 1% on Yardbook's free plan.
Not after the trial. Invoice Simple offers a 14-day trial of its Premium plan on mobile; paid plans start at $6.99/mo (Essentials, up to 3 invoices a month), per its pricing page checked 2026-11-16.
